_how: Copy an entry into lamps.json for each real lamp. no = its stamped number, status = available | spoken for | to order | sold, price in dollars, image = a file you put in photos/, buyUrl = an https checkout link (eBay, Etsy, Stripe). details shows on the lamp page.
